description: an annotated report of the Sprite Powers tab of a sprite actor sheet. Top panel (the original issue attachment, verbatim): three section headers each with their own +Add button, with the two 'Optional Sprite Powers' headers and their +Add buttons circled and arrows running from those buttons up to the general 'Sprite Powers' section where the powers they create actually end up; a further circle marks the general section's own +Add with the note that it opens a Critter Power sheet and adds nothing to the tab. Bottom panel: the same three sections with one power in each, marking (a) an enable/disable control rendered on the non-optional power, (b) the same control missing from the power that needs it, (c) the two optional sections holding each other's powers, and (d) a note that using the control moves a power to the other optional heading while leaving it in the opposite on/off state to the one that heading means
